p92_p94_conclusion: The depth-trace system improved PROCESS RIGOR/SAFETY (forced traces, resolved in-scope reads, well-formed abstains, 0 false escalations, 0 severity FP across 4 depth-equipped runs) but has NOT improved CONVERSION (4 consecutive 0-conversion blind runs). On this high-density subject it produced a CONFIDENT-BUT-WRONG completed REJECT of a true High (H-01) and false-cleared a true Medium (M-05). The P94 completion gate guarantees a trace is DONE, not that it is CORRECT. The bottleneck is now clearly BLIND REASONING CORRECTNESS / boundary-case discovery on well-engineered code -- a capability limit that selection policy, the (validated) gate, and depth-completion discipline do not address.
